Specification: A TLA+ formalization of proofs for Lamport's distributed mutual exclusion algorithm. It establishes type correctness, basic safety invariants (NetworkInv, CommInv), clock-related invariants (ClockInv), and finally verifies the Mutual Exclusion (Mutex) property using hierarchical proofs and various provers (Zenon, Isa, SMTT).
TheoremNames: LEMMA BroadcastType == ASSUME network \in [Proc -> [Proc -> Seq(Message)]], NEW s \in Proc, NEW m \in Message PROVE  Broadcast(s,m) \in [Proc -> Seq(Message)]
IfThenElse: IF c > clock[p] THEN c + 1 ELSE @ + 1 (in ReceiveRequest)
IF n=q THEN network[n][q] ELSE Append(network[n][q], RelMessage) (in Exit)
IF m.clock > clock[n] THEN m.clock + 1 ELSE clock[n]+1 (in ReceiveRequest)
FunctionConstructor: [q \in Proc |-> IF n=q THEN network[n][q] ELSE Append(network[n][q], RelMessage)]
FunctionOverride: [clock EXCEPT ![p] = IF c > clock[p] THEN c + 1 ELSE @ + 1]
[network EXCEPT ![n] = [q \in Proc |-> IF n=q THEN network[n][q] ELSE Append(network[n][q], RelMessage)]]
AssumeProveBlocks: ASSUME network \in [Proc -> [Proc -> Seq(Message)]], NEW s \in Proc, NEW m \in Message PROVE  Broadcast(s,m) \in [Proc -> Seq(Message)]
ASSUME NEW p \in Proc, Request(p) PROVE  TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW p \in Proc, NEW q \in Proc \ {p}, ReceiveRequest(p,q) PROVE  TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), NEW mtype, ~ Contains(s,mtype) PROVE  AtMostOne(s, mtype)
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), NEW mt1, NEW mt2, ~ Contains(s, mt2) PROVE  /\ Precedes(s, mt1, mt2) /\ Precedes(s, mt2, mt1)
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), NEW mt1, NEW mt2, s # << >>, Precedes(s,mt1,mt2), Head(s).type = mt2 PROVE  ~ Contains(s,mt1)
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), s # << >>, NEW mtype, AtMostOne(s, mtype) PROVE  Contains(Tail(s), mtype) <=> Contains(s, mtype) /\ Head(s).type # mtype
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), NEW mtype, ~ Contains(s, mtype), NEW m \in Message PROVE  /\ AtMostOne(Append(s,m), mtype) /\ m.type # mtype => ~ Contains(Append(s,m), mtype)
ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Message), s # << >>, NEW mt1, NEW mt2, mt1 # mt2, Head(s).type = mt1 / Head(s).type \notin {mt1, mt2}, Precedes(Tail(s), mt1, mt2) PROVE  Precedes(s, mt1, mt2)
SUFFICES ASSUME TypeOK, BasicInv, [Next]_vars PROVE  BasicInv'
ASSUME NEW p \in Proc, NEW q \in Proc PROVE  NetworkInv(p,q)'
ASSUME NEW q \in Proc \ {n} PROVE  /\ q \notin ack'[p] /\ Contains(network'[p][q], "req") /\ ~ Contains(network'[q][p], "ack")
SUFFICES ASSUME TypeOK, BasicInv, ClockInv, [Next]_vars PROVE  ClockInv'

ASSUME Contains(qp', "ack") / q \in ack'[p] PROVE  /\ req'[q][p] = req[p][p] /\ clock'[q] > req'[p][p] /\ Precedes(qp', "ack", "req") => \A i \in 1 .. Len(qp') : qp'[i].type = "req" => qp'[i].clock > req'[p][p]
ASSUME Precedes(qp', "ack", "req"), NEW i \in 1 .. Len(qp'), qp'[i].type = "req" PROVE  FALSE
SUFFICES ASSUME TypeOK, BasicInv, ClockInv, NEW p \in crit, NEW q \in crit, p # q PROVE  FALSE
